title: Die-cut sheet on clicker press
setting: Footwear factory, standing at a clicker press
contact_roles: the right hand places and lifts the steel cutting die; the left hand pulls the press handle for the cut and takes the cut piece away. The press head is not one of the outlined objects, so a hand swinging or pushing it reads as free. Parts of this clip's contact were corrected by a reviewer watching the video, where the automatic cues missed it (contact.parquet marks those frames labelled_by = review).
